channel.title: Sidebar
channel.description: The five best design links, every weekday.

item.title: Send and sign agreements from Claude with Lumin
item.description: Need to send an agreement? Draft it in Claude and send it for eSignature with the free Lumin connector, all without leaving the chat.

item.title: Slop is moving up the stack
item.description: Agents write cleaner lines of code than a year ago. The slop moved into design... What's next?

item.title: Iconden
item.description: A community-submitted gallery of iPhone app icons. Browse, track redesigns, and submit icons you’ve spotted in prod.

item.title: Guess the Year
item.description: Like GeoGuessr, but for history: read the event, pin its year, score up to 5,000 a round.

item.title: Glue work is still harmful in the age of AI
item.description: Processes that can only be sustained by the unrewarded sacrifice of engineers ought to die.

item.title: Building interfaces that understand what we want to do
item.description: Chrome is building a Decisions API that runs a decision model on your computer, for free and privately.

item.title: Below the surface
item.description: The archaeological research project of the North/South metro line lends the River Amstel a voice in the historical portrayal of Amsterdam.

item.title: If X, then Y
item.description: It was never easy to predict the future, but at the moment it feels near impossible.

item.title: Bodega cats of New York
item.description: Photographs and stories of the cats who live in New York’s bodegas, and the people who know them by name.

item.title: Where the disabled button got its rule
item.description: What Apple’s 1980 rules said about greyed-out commands.

item.title: Design is a search problem
item.description: Most of what we call ‘design’ is groping around a dark room looking for a black cat.

item.title: Airline Logos
item.description: From Lufthansa’s crane to United’s tulip, the stories behind twelve airline logos designed for the jet age.

item.title: I made a film in Excel
item.description: A testament to the inescapable pull of making something out of nothing.

item.title: State of JavaScript 2026
item.description: Take the State of JavaScript survey: a programming language that grew up much, much bigger than anybody ever anticipated.

item.title: By taking away
item.description: Software used to be made like a painting, one layer at a time. With agents, it’s closer to sculpture, and the hard part is seeing what to keep.

item.title: Don’t make a human do what AI is amazing at
item.description: How Nunebot makes my apps a little better every day without me doing the tedious parts.

item.title: 1 in 8 billion
item.description: Become one of the babies being born right now and live their whole life inside the real statistics of 172 countries and territories.

item.title: A family tree of software job titles
item.description: If you’ve been in this industry for any length of time you’ll have seen titles come and go, and you might have wondered where they all came from.

item.title: The components of agent memory
item.description: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what’s worth remembering before it knows what’s next.

item.title: There’s no better name for design systems
item.description: How to talk about design systems across functions.
